title: UREES 026
shortDescription: One-off garment made by reworking an existing piece of clothing.
longStory: Each UREES piece begins as a found garment. I cut, alter and stitch the garment to make a one-off piece.

title: UREES Drop 02: Piece VII
shortDescription: A one-off piece from the second UREES drop.
longStory: Part of an ongoing series of upcycled garments. This piece carries the memory of its previous life and the mark of its transformation.
